description: Returns recent block production information from the current or previous epoch.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The configuration object with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: commitment
sub_parameters.description: The level of commitment required for the query. The options include:

sub_parameters.name: range
sub_parameters.description: The slot range to return block production for. If parameter is not provided, the default value is current epoch

sub_parameters.name: firstSlot
sub_parameters.description: The first slot to return block production information for (inclusive)

sub_parameters.name: lastSlot
sub_parameters.description: The last slot to return block production information for (inclusive). If the parameter is not provided, the default value is highest slot

sub_parameters.name: identity
sub_parameters.description: The results for this validator identity encoded in base-58

result.description: The custom object with the following field

result.context.description: The additional context to retrieve the block production information

result.context.slot.description: The slot number to retrieve block production information

result.value.description: Information about the block production in the specified slot range

result.value.byIdentity.description: A dictionary of validator identities, as base-58 encoded strings. Value is a two element array containing the number of leader slots and the number of blocks produced

result.value.range.firstSlot.description: The first slot of the block production information (inclusive)

result.value.range.lastSlot.description: The last slot of the block production information (inclusive)
